cases.prompt: I've downloaded FileMaker Server 26 and want to install it on Docker Desktop on my Mac.
cases.expected: Triggers the skill; follows the pre-flight checks, builds from Claris's Dockerfile (not fms_Docker_Installer.sh), pins ubuntu:24.04, creates named volumes, runs the container, and walks through the assisted-install wizard.

cases.prompt: FileMaker Server's Admin Console is showing 89% disk usage but I don't think that's right.
cases.expected: Triggers the skill via the disk-usage symptom trigger; identifies a bind-mounted install folder as the likely cause and points to the troubleshooting reference's disk-usage section rather than guessing.

cases.prompt: I ran docker rm on my FMS container and now fmsadmin says command not found, but the databases still show up in the volume.
cases.expected: Triggers the skill via the 'FMS software disappearing after a container was recreated' symptom; recognizes the container-vs-image trap and walks through reinstalling on top of the existing data via troubleshooting.md, then recommends committing an image going forward.

cases.prompt: Claris released a FileMaker Server update overnight. My FMS runs in Docker — can you update it?
cases.expected: Triggers the skill; runs the staleness check against Claris's updater feed and the container's dpkg version; asks the developer for the licence-linked Linux zip rather than downloading it; then follows U1–U7: diff the packages, snapshot to a dated pre-upgrade tag, stop the container and back up all four volumes, dry-run the .deb, hand the interactive install to a named terminal tab with the licence prompt left to the developer, verify, delete the .deb before committing. On 26.0.3+ does not re-apply the Step 6 Nginx patch without asking.

near_misses.prompt: Can you write me a FileMaker script that finds all overdue invoices?
near_misses.why: FileMaker Pro script authoring, not server/Docker infrastructure — should route to fmp-dev-* skills instead.

near_misses.prompt: How do I set up a Windows Server VM to host FileMaker Server?
near_misses.why: Not Docker-related; this skill is specifically Docker-container installs, not general Windows/VM hosting.
